record.paper_title: Open problems on compact constant mean curvature surfaces with boundary
record.context_brief: numerical visualization of Kapouleas boundary examples
record.original_question: Produce numerical visualizations of the Kapouleas examples of constant-mean-curvature surfaces with circular boundary.

evidence.quote: Problem 2.10. Give numerical pictures of the Kapouleas’ examples with circular boundary.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A constant mean curvature (CMC) surface in Euclidean three-space $\mathbb{R}^3$ is a smooth immersed surface $\Sigma \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ whose mean curvature $H$ is a (nonzero) constant. By a gluing/singular-perturbation construction, one can produce, for each sufficiently large genus $g$, compact immersed CMC surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^3$ whose boundary is a single round circle: starting from a balanced graph whose vertices correspond to small unit spheres and whose edges correspond to thin pieces of unduloids (Delaunay surfaces), an implicit function theorem argument perturbs the resulting approximate surface into a genuine CMC surface with $H = 1$ and circular boundary. These existence results are non-constructive and yield no explicit shape.

Task: Produce explicit numerical visualizations (e.g., via the conjugate surface / discrete CMC methods, or by direct numerical solution of the CMC boundary value problem) of such compact constant mean curvature surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^3$ that have a single round circle as their boundary and that arise from the above gluing construction with prescribed underlying balanced graph. In particular, render at least one example for some genus $g \ge 2$, displaying the surface together with its circular boundary.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search returned general references on numerical CMC surface construction (e.g., Große-Brauckmann–Polthier conjugate surface method) and on Kapouleas' gluing construction, but no specific publication producing numerical pictures of the Kapouleas examples with circular boundary was located. The status of this visualization problem is therefore unclear from available sources.

status_evidence.title: Numerical Examples of Compact Constant Mean Curvature Surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Große-Brauckmann and Polthier constructed new examples of compact CMC surfaces numerically using a conjugate surface method.
status_evidence.claim: Numerical methods exist for compact CMC surfaces, but no explicit visualization of Kapouleas' circular-boundary examples is documented here.

status_evidence.title: Constant mean curvature surfaces with circular boundary in R³
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of CMC surfaces with circular boundary, mentioning Kapouleas' non-embedded examples of higher genus.
status_evidence.claim: Kapouleas' examples are known to exist but are described abstractly without numerical pictures.
